steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Last night, a pair of giant wooden puppets appeared in the street art community. Their magnificence shocked everyone who had the opportunity to see them.

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: These fine puppets were created by one of the local artists, and during yesterday's rehearsal, they waltzed and fluttered under the moonlight.

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: We can see from the video how they danced so elegantly under the artists' control. Almost as if they were alive!

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: The neighborhood is known for violence, gangs, and homeless, contributing to a high crime rate. It's an area that most usually steer clear of. But despite the risks, the performance last night attracted lots of visitors.

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Now, let's go to our reporter on the scene and see what the attendees have to say.

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: Yo, Boss, un helado, por favor.

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: Boss?

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Señor, what were you doing when the two puppets showed up?

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: I was jogging at the time. Suddenly, I saw a huge face between two buildings. I was so shocked, I fell to the ground.

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: But then I mustered up my courage, walked over there and watched the whole performance...

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: And when it was all over, my legs couldn't stop shaking. I wasn't scared this time, though. I was stunned.

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Okay. Thank you again for your time, señor.

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Haha, from the way he's walking, it looks like he was telling the truth. Now let us turn the camera over to some of the artists who live here.

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Maybe we can ask them why they made this pair of giant puppets? What stories will they have for us?

steps.name: Casino Dealer
steps.text: Señores, señoras, please place your bets.

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: Shh...

steps.name: Casino Dealer
steps.text: Excuse me?

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: Oh, look at the little girl who just walked by. She's one of the main players here. Señorita, a moment, please?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Hmm...?

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: I hear you're the mastermind behind this performance. For you to take on such a major role at your age...

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Yeah yeah, get to the point. I'm busy.

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: Sure. What's with the two puppets?

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: Did you go through all that trouble to draw attention to this community?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Heh, a few years ago, two buildings in our neighborhood burned down in a fire. None of you turned your attention to us.

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: A fire...?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: (Quietly) Nobody remembers... I knew it.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: The puppet show is to commemorate that fire. It's to commemorate our friends who left us that day. That's why we arranged to open our festival on the same day as the fire.

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: But Galería Krysztauowa is also scheduled to have its widely anticipated opening ceremony that day. Is there any pressure from that at all?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Maybe a little before the rehearsal, but basically not at all now.

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: The performance on our opening day will be even more sensational. I don't think an art museum can hold a candle to our performance.

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: No matter how they spruce up their gimmicks, their opening ceremony is only there to tell us one thing—

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: That Reynell can do business.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Why did you turn off the TV, Miłosz? I was watching that.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: You should get some sleep.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I don't want to. I'm not tired at all.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Sleep.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Miłosz... Why are you frowning like that? Why aren't you happy for me?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Go to sleep, Reynell.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: It's been more than a decade. The birthday present that should've been mine is finally back in my hands. I'm delighted.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Really? Look at what a mess you are now. Say what you want, I'm not convinced.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: That music box was supposed to be mine... Before my birthday... she said she'd give me one.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: But that old bastard wasn't happy about it. How could she have made a piece with absolutely no economic value?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: She's a genius, a star. Her works are meant to be sold at exhibitions for high prices. It wasn't meant to sit on a boy's bedside table, never to be known by the masses.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: But it's made it back to you. After so many years, it returned to its rightful owner.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I love it. Even though it's been modified beyond recognition, I love it.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: What about her, Miłosz? Will she like my gift?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Everything you've given her, she couldn't bear to let go.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Why aren't you saying anything?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: ...I do want to sleep now, Miłosz.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: I saw you on TV. You shouldn't have showed off like that for the media.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Papá, you're the one who suggested we make the giant puppets. If you were going to worry about showing off, you should've thought of that sooner.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: *sigh*, Tecno. I just got a letter from the government.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: The letter says that if the arts festival is a success, a group of Leithanian cultural exchange representatives will come to our puppet show.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: You mean... we might get government support?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: It's more likely we'll end up at their beck and call.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Warlords, merchants, politicians. There are plenty of men with their eyes on this plot of land. We're getting too much attention in too short a period of time. It's too much pressure.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Maybe this just goes to show how useless I am.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Don't say that, Papá. Before you got here, nobody cared if this place burned for a whole day and night. There wasn't even anyone here to report on it.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: It's because you've been here for us that we got to live peaceful lives the past couple years. All of us know the work you've been putting in for our sakes.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Everything you've done, you did so we could walk under the sun again, no?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: We're another step closer to our goal now. What are you worried about?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Let me think about it some more... Tecno...

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: I can't let the rest of you walk under the sun without any protection.

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: Señor Miłosz, have you and Señor Reynell seen the street art community's puppet show?

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: You chose to hold Galería Krysztauowa's opening ceremony on the same day as their arts festival. Certainly their successful rehearsal has taken away much of the attention that deservedly would have been yours.

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: Do you feel any pressure?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Please make way, ma'am.

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: Señor Miłosz, please answer our questions!

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Sorry, but we are not planning on taking anything from the press today.

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: Señor Miłosz, is your silence an indication of the pressure you're under?

steps.name: Security
steps.text: That's close enough, señora.

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: Señor Miłosz!

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Is Miss Ela here yet?

steps.name: Security
steps.text: Yes. She's waiting in the exhibition hall.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: I need to talk to her. Make sure nobody disturbs us.

steps.name: Security
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Miss Ela, sorry to keep you waiting. You'll have to forgive me. The outside is packed with reporters.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Mr. Miłosz, why did you call me back from the art community all of a sudden?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: You're getting along well with them, aren't you?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Yes, I am.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: The people there are vivacious.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: And even though some of them are sick, their urge to create is as strong as ever.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: People who call themselves artists are a dime a dozen, but I have to admit that the people there truly love art.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: What about Reynell? What do you think of him?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: He... He's an interesting man.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Is that all?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I'm afraid I can't see any of that in him.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: You once told me that Mr. Szczepan's paintings made you uncomfortable. That's because you have never met him. The discomfort that his personal presence brings to others is a hundred times greater than that of his paintings.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: If it wasn't for him. You would've seen those qualities in Reynell.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Nothing is beneath Szczepan as Kazimierz's most famous artwork dealer, be it verbal attacks, threats of violence, or economic suppression.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: He will do whatever it takes to make the artists working with him follow his every command. Not even his wife, Reynell's mother, could escape this fate.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: That's a pain no creator could bear. It must have been an agonizing marriage.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: You're right. She even destroyed her own work as a form of protest, but only a week later, the damaged portrait was sold at auction for an astronomical price on account of its so-called profound philosophical meaning.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: She should've left.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: She couldn't. She couldn't leave her child to the arrogant bastard, especially a child that very much resembled herself.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: (Deep breath)

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Is there a reason you're trying to get me to sympathize with him now, of all times, Mr. Miłosz?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: You're a sharp one, to the point that it's frustrating.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Galería Krysztauowa's opening ceremony is set to be held on the anniversary of Reynell's mother's passing. The day has a special significance to him.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Perhaps you and your team can help him out a little. Just a short while will do. If you could work it so the two events are even just one day apart.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I'm sorry, Mr. Miłosz, but I can't.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: If you've seen the news, then you know what that day means to the community.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Miss Ela... You should do what you can. This isn't a request. It's a reminder.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: It doesn't matter how emotional or stirring their puppet show is. It will be overshadowed on the day the Galería opens.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: You're awake.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Were you outside?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Yes, I met with Miss Ela.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: What did she say?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: She refused.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I'm not surprised.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Why did you ask me to call her back here?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: The puppet show would be in good hands if she were to run it... And then, perhaps there would come a day when it forms an iconic performance that represents this place, as they hope it will.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: But it won't be on that day.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I almost sympathize with them. They're spending so much time, effort, and energy on this...

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: To tell the truth, if it wasn't for the scheduling conflict, I would even go see the performance myself. Compared to the junk that the art buyers are gobbling up downstairs...

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I'm a lot more interested in their creation.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: It's been some years since you last said you liked a particular piece.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Right. Let them be. It's just a shame...

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: No matter how overwhelming a piece of art is in the beginning, it can't compare to a magnificent death.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: The last explosives are in place. I will make the final adjustments tomorrow to ensure that everything goes as planned on the day of the ceremony.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Thank you for everything you've done, Miłosz. For me.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: No thanks necessary. Did you know, Reynell? When you talked about destruction just now, your eyes were sparkling...

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Just like when you used to talk to me about creation.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: It's just similar, that's all.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: But it's more than enough to me.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Who is it...? Why now?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: It's fine. I'll go get it.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: How's a single phone call taking so long?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: (Mouths) He won't shut up!

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: (Mouths) Who is it?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: (Mouths) That captain!

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: (Mouths) What does he want?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: (Mouths) What else could it be? The community!

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Whatever. Give me the phone.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Hello, Mr. Mateo? Yes, I'm very busy right now. If you need anything, we'll talk later.
The man briskly hangs up the phone and rips the line out.
